summary: The text discusses various proposed changes to the E-Rate program, including limiting or sunsetting the program, narrowing eligibility, restricting special construction, changing the discount matrix, and addressing vendor influence. It also mentions tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes and conditions related to screen time and parental autonomy. The changes are expected to have significant budgetary impacts on school districts and communities.

claims.evidence_quote: Changes to e-rates will substantially affect our budget, and impact service to students and to our community.
